description: This file defines the interface and class for a TextToSpeech plugin implementation in a C++ project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and notifications related to Text-to-Speech functionalities, along with necessary includes and licensing information.

classes.name: TextToSpeech
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing TextToSpeech services, handling initialization, deinitialization, and voice notification management.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling various notification callbacks related to TTS events, forwarding these notifications to observers.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, setting up necessary services.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Performs speech synthesis with given parameters.

methods.name: IsSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if TTS is currently speaking.

methods.name: SetACL
methods.description: Sets Access Control List for TTS.

methods.name: dispatchJsonEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a JSON event with specified data.
